releases.name: v0.116.0
releases.notes:
### Added Features

- duplicate RHSAs to all applicable RHEL minor versions [PR [#3542](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3542) @willmurphyscode]
- add chainguard osv transformer [PR [#3474](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3474) @crosleyzack]
- populate package architecture for matching [PR [#3504](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3504) @willmurphyscode]
- lightweight reachability analysis to reduce Golang false positives [Issue [#2960](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/2960)] [PR [#3509](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3509) @spiffcs]
- Deduplicate Go matches that are aliases of each other (same CVE reported under both a `govulndb` GO-* ID and its GHSA) [Issue [#3511](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3511)] [PR [#3509](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3509) @spiffcs]
- Support Ubuntu ESM [Issue [#3544](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3544)] [PR [#3546](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3546) @wagoodman]

### Bug Fixes

- regenerate v6.1.8 blob and sql schemas [PR [#3574](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3574) @spiffcs]
- rhel version streams [PR [#3572](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3572) @kzantow]
- Grype doesn't match u-boot in SBOM if type is set to firmware [Issue [#2537](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/2537)]
- Ignore Go compiler affecting CVE when Docker image only contains a binary compiled with Go [Issue [#1782](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/1782)]
- Zarf scans emit warnings for consistently unreadable files (i.e., included non-SBOMs) [Issue [#3516](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3516)] [PR [#3545](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3545) @brandtkeller]
- Fail parsing github actions [Issue [#3220](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3220)]
- Go vulnerability returned when installed version is greater than fixed version [Issue [#3520](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3520)]

### Dependencies

releases.name: v0.115.0
releases.notes:
### Added Features

- emit golang.org/x/net vulns from govlundb [PR [#3534](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3534) @willmurphyscode]
- Merge Go vuln matches with GHSA matches [Issue [#3515](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3515)]

### Bug Fixes

- only emit records for stdlib [PR [#3527](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3527) @willmurphyscode]
- mark hummingbird distro as rolling [PR [#3521](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3521) @willmurphyscode]
- disable go stdlib CPE matching by default [PR [#3517](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3517) @willmurphyscode]
- merge in custom ranges when applicable [PR [#3514](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3514) @willmurphyscode]
- exclude linux-kbuild deb indirect matches by default [PR [#3506](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3506) @westonsteimel]
- avoid panic on invalid RHEL version IDs [PR [#3490](https://github.com/anchore/grype/pull/3490) @jspilman]
- Support reading CycloneDX 1.7 SBOMs [Issue [#3373](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3373)]
- Grype cannot read mariadb version correctly [Issue [#3452](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3452)]
- grype hangs when downloading certain images using registry client [Issue [#3492](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3492)]
- Can we get a fix for these Critical findings reported for grype [Issue [#3484](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3484)]

### Additional Changes

- Security: bump golang.org/x/crypto to v0.52.0 to resolve multiple CVEs [Issue [#3493](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3493)]
- Security: bump golang.org/x/net to v0.55.0 to resolve CVEs [Issue [#3494](https://github.com/anchore/grype/issues/3494)]

### Dependencies

35 dependency changes (31 updated, 3 added, 1 removed). 5 vulnerabilities remediated.
